cohort: 306 women with pre-gestational diabetes mellitus who gave birth by elective CS between 36(+0) and 38(+6) weeks gestation
finding: This study did not demonstrate any statistically significant beneficial or harmful effects of ACS in neonates of women with PGDM who are born by elective CS.
mod_finding: This study investigated the effects of antenatal corticosteroid (ACS) administration in women with pre-gestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) undergoing elective caesarean section (CS) after 36 weeks gestation, finding no statistically significant beneficial or harmful effects.
